title: Configure a calendar system timer
goal: Schedule a system timer with an unprivileged job.
challenge: Create named timer/service, run job only as its disposable account, prove loaded limits, real result/private report and exact cleanup.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-s6 && ! getent group ll-s6 && test ! -e /home/ll-s6 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-s6 && test ! -e /etc/systemd/system/ll-s6.service && test ! -e /etc/systemd/system/ll-s6.timer && test "$(systemctl --no-pager show ll-s6.service -p LoadState --value)" = not-found && test "$(systemctl --no-pager show ll-s6.timer -p LoadState --value)" = not-found

printf '%s
' '#!/bin/bash' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin 'umask 077' '[ "$(id -un)" = ll-s6 ] || exit 2' 'cd /home/ll-s6 || exit 3' 'printf "user=%s
" "$(id -un)" > report.txt &&' 'printf "stamp=%s
" "$(date -Is)" >> report.txt' | sudo tee /home/ll-s6/job.sh > /dev/null && sudo chown ll-s6:ll-s6 /home/ll-s6/job.sh && sudo chmod 0700 /home/ll-s6/job.sh

printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=Disposable scheduling practice' '[Service]' Type=exec User=ll-s6 Group=ll-s6 WorkingDirectory=/home/ll-s6 'ExecStart=/usr/bin/timeout -k 1s 5s /home/ll-s6/job.sh' UMask=0077 RuntimeMaxSec=6s MemoryMax=64M TasksMax=16 StandardOutput=null StandardError=journal | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/ll-s6.service > /dev/null; printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=Disposable calendar practice' '[Timer]' 'OnCalendar=*-*-* *:*:0/10' AccuracySec=1us Persistent=false Unit=ll-s6.service '[Install]' WantedBy=timers.target | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/ll-s6.timer > /dev/null
steps.explanation: Type=exec explicit User/Group and calendar timer.

steps.command: sudo systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/ll-s6.service /etc/systemd/system/ll-s6.timer; sudo systemctl --no-pager daemon-reload; sudo systemctl --no-pager enable --now ll-s6.timer
steps.expected: Every10seconds with explicit accuracy, not real-time guarantee.

steps.command: end=$((SECONDS+85)); until sudo test -s /home/ll-s6/report.txt; do test "$SECONDS" -lt "$end" || break; sleep 1; done; sudo runuser -u ll-s6 -- cat /home/ll-s6/report.txt; sudo stat -c "%U:%G %a %s" /home/ll-s6/report.txt; systemctl --no-pager show ll-s6.service -p LoadState -p User -p Group -p RuntimeMaxUSec -p MemoryMax -p TasksMax -p Result -p ExecMainStatus; systemctl --no-pager show ll-s6.timer -p LoadState -p LastTriggerUSec -p NextElapseUSecRealtime
steps.explanation: Trigger alone insufficient: inspect loaded config/result/file.

hints: Timer scope differs from job User.
Calendar uses guest clock, no clock adjustment.
Absolute paths and actual owner matter.
review: Loaded bounds, trigger, status0, private ll-s6 report.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 107.2 partial cron/systemd timers; 105.2/108.2 reinforcement; self-reviewed, unscored. No at or full objective coverage.
